value.rationale: The complete positive interior optimum is a physically motivated capacity-allocation problem; its non-corner solution holds even for fully polarized initial motion and any starting interior position. The exact effective bias gives a substantive equivalence between position and orientation preparation, and the theorem provides a globally unique exact policy rather than an ad hoc chosen ratio. Does not assert fundamentally new MFPT machinery or noisy-estimation stability.
